forbidden_claims.reason: File-local indices are not canonical identity.
Only the TES4 light flag establishes light origin.

A structural conflict alone is not a finding.
XESP is outside the EVAL-0052 positive allowlist.
Archive and localized-string resolution are unsupported.

known_limits: The oracle covers only the frozen EVAL-0052 positive allowlist.
Decompressed logical offsets are distinct from physical file offsets.
No production parser, Mutagen, xEdit, held-out input, or taxonomy answer authored these values.
